svg.title: SLR sub-pipelines: projections, hazard input and sampling
svg.desc: slr_input_hazard loads SLR GeoTIFFs from a hazard CSV and samples an exposure on each. slr_input_nasa_projections looks up SLR by year and scenario, e.g. 2032 under SSP2-4.5 P50 gives 0.15m. Both feed slr_sample_hazard, which interpolates depth from the SLR value: 0.15m gives 0.65m.
